Sovereign Call.name: Sovereign Call
Sovereign Call.description: The user's signature move: they read a whole crowd and call out the one question nearly everyone in earshot answers without thinking. Everyone who answers, ally, enemy or bystander, falls under the user's control and obeys a single shared command, such as kneel, drop your weapons or walk to the exits, until hurt, shaken or the scene ends; afterward the user's voice gives out until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
